cdc_doses_distributed.name: Influenza vaccine doses distributed (CDC FluVaxView)
cdc_doses_distributed.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
cdc_doses_distributed.location: Weekly Cumulative Doses (in Millions) of Influenza Vaccines Distributed by Season, United States
cdc_doses_distributed.description: Influenza vaccine is produced by private manufacturers, which together with a subset of wholesalers and distributors report to CDC each week the number of doses they have shipped in the United States. CDC publishes the cumulative total for each week of the season, from late July through early March, for the 2018-19 season onward. The figures approximate all doses distributed nationally, are not projections, and say nothing about how many doses were administered.
cdc_doses_distributed.restrictions: Public domain. CDC data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
